full_prompt_en: A square hand-painted aviation illustration shows an elderly pilot and a small piglike companion seated together in the open cockpit of a red biplane. The pilot occupies the right half in a close three-quarter view. His weathered face turns toward the viewer with a restrained smile under a broad white moustache and pointed white beard. A bright red leather flying cap covers his head, with round brass-rimmed blue goggles resting above his eyes and a loose ear flap projecting to the right. He wears a pale khaki jacket over darker olive layers; a thick gloved hand rests on the cockpit edge in the lower center. To his left, the small pink-eared companion sits close to a vertical control handle, its wrinkled snout and open mouth facing forward. The scarlet cockpit wall rises diagonally across the lower frame. Rows of small dark rivets, thin seams, weathered scratches, and warm orange highlights articulate its curved metal skin. Above them, a broad shadowed teal wing spans the image on a diagonal; fine braces and an engine with a dark propeller recede toward the upper left. Pale blue-green cloud shapes fill the narrow openings between wing, windshield frame, and figures. The perspective brings the pair near the viewer while the aircraft structure layers behind and above them. Black-brown ink contours vary from decisive edges around goggles, rivets, and noses to loose broken marks in hair and clothing. Short hatch strokes and translucent brushlike color patches give the face, canvas, and metal their worn texture. Diffuse daylight catches the red cap, white beard, khaki sleeve, and cockpit rim, while olive and blue-green shadows collect below the wing and under the faces. Vermilion red is the dominant accent against faded turquoise, warm cream, khaki, and soot brown. A slightly mottled paper surface and softened color edges make the whole image feel like a weathered storybook painting of an adventurous flight.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形手绘航空插画呈现一位年长飞行员与一只小猪模样的伙伴，并肩坐在红色双翼机的敞开驾驶舱里。飞行员以近距离四分之三侧面占据右半幅。饱经风霜的面孔转向观者，宽大的白胡子和尖形白须下带着克制的笑意。鲜红皮革飞行帽盖住头部，镶黄铜边的蓝色圆护目镜架在眼睛上方，一片松开的护耳向右伸出。他身穿浅卡其外套，内层颜色偏深橄榄绿；戴着厚手套的手搭在画面下方中央的舱沿。左侧，小猪伙伴紧靠一根竖直操纵杆，粉色耳朵、皱起的鼻吻与张开的嘴朝向前方。朱红色驾驶舱壁沿下部斜斜升起，成排深色铆钉、细接缝、磨损划痕和暖橙色亮部交代弯曲的金属表皮。上方，一片处于阴影里的青绿色机翼斜跨画面；细支架以及带深色螺旋桨的发动机向左上方退去。浅蓝绿云层填入机翼、风挡框与人物之间的狭窄空隙。透视让两位乘员贴近观者，机身结构则在他们身后和上方逐层展开。黑褐色墨线在护目镜、铆钉和鼻部形成明确边缘，在毛发与衣褶中转为松散断续的笔痕。短促排线与半透明刷色，使面孔、布料和金属都带有久经使用的肌理。漫射日光照在红帽、白须、卡其袖子与舱沿，橄榄绿及蓝绿色阴影聚在机翼下方和面孔下缘。朱红是画面的主强调色，衬以褪色青绿、暖奶油色、卡其和烟褐色。略有斑驳的纸面与柔化的色块边缘，让整幅画像一页讲述冒险飞行的旧绘本。
style_prompt_en: Use an aged hand-painted adventure-illustration treatment with lively ink drawing beneath translucent, slightly uneven color. Establish a clear foreground silhouette with bold vermilion or rust-red shapes, then layer darker teal structures and pale turquoise atmospheric openings behind it. Vary black-brown contour weight: crisp around constructed edges and focal details, broken and sketchlike through soft surfaces. Add short hatching, dry brush patches, weathering marks, and subtle mottled paper grain rather than smooth digital gradients. Build convincing volume through overlapping planes, warm highlights, and cool olive-blue recesses. Let diffuse daylight illuminate the main forms without hard glossy reflections. Keep the palette limited to faded turquoise, teal, khaki, warm cream, smoky brown, and concentrated red. Compose at close range with a strong diagonal structural rhythm, readable negative spaces, and enough small mechanical marks to suggest a lived-in world while preserving the broad hand-painted shapes.
style_prompt_zh: 采用旧式手绘冒险插画的处理方式，让富于变化的墨线托住半透明且略不均匀的色层。以前景清楚的朱红或锈红色大形建立视觉重心，在后方叠入较深的青绿色结构与浅青色空气空隙。黑褐轮廓线粗细有别：构造边缘和焦点细部清晰，柔软表面则以断续速写线处理。加入短排线、干刷色斑、磨损痕迹与细微斑驳纸纹，避免平滑的数字渐变。利用形体重叠、暖色亮部和橄榄蓝色深处塑造可信体积。以漫射日光照亮主要形体，表面不过分光亮。配色约束在褪色青绿、深青、卡其、暖奶油、烟褐与集中的红色之间。近距离构图使用有力的斜向结构节奏、可辨的负空间及适量机械小笔迹，暗示长期使用的世界，同时保持大块手绘形状清楚。
theme_en: An elderly pilot and a small pig companion in a red biplane cockpit
theme_zh: 一位年长飞行员与小猪伙伴坐在红色双翼机驾驶舱中
name: Porco Rosso
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
